name: Air Quality Monitoring
description: Tridel provides state-of-the-art air quality monitoring systems providing real-time data on key pollutants. Our solutions are designed for industrial sites, urban areas, and coastal regions to ensure environmental safety and compliance.

name: Atmospheric & Underwater Noise
description: Tridel offers advanced monitoring services for both atmospheric and underwater noise. Our solutions help in assessing environmental impact, ensuring regulatory compliance, and protecting marine life from acoustic pollution.

name: GeoInformatics (GIS)
description: We transform complex spatial data into intuitive visual insights. Our GeoInformatics services range from enterprise GIS implementation to custom application development, helping clients manage, analyze, and display their geospatial assets effectively.

name: GeoScience
description: Tridel Technologies provides comprehensive GeoScience solutions, integrating environmental science with advanced technology to deliver precise and actionable insights for marine and coastal projects. Our team of experts conducts rigorous studies to ensure environmental compliance and sustainable development.

name: Gravity Coring
description: Our Gravity Coring services provide an efficient and cost-effective method for widespread sediment sampling in soft seabed environments. Utilizing a free-falling corer, we recover undisturbed samples suitable for stratigraphic analysis and chemical testing. This technique is ideal for rapid seabed characterization over large areas.

name: Ground Water Monitoring
description: Tridel offers expert ground water monitoring services to support aquifer management, contaminant tracking, and sustainable resource usage.

name: Hydrography
description: Comprehensive geophysical and hydrographic surveys for marine projects. Our services employ state-of-the-art sonar and positioning technology to map the seabed with high precision. From route surveys for pipelines to port construction monitoring, we deliver data that ensures safe navigation and successful engineering.

name: Marine and Onshore Boreholes
description: Our marine and onshore borehole services provide comprehensive geotechnical data for complex infrastructure projects. Using advanced drilling rigs and sampling techniques, we recover high-quality soil and rock core samples to determine stratigraphy and engineering properties. From nearshore construction to offshore wind farm developments, our borehole investigations are conducted to the highest safety and industry standards.

name: Navigational Charting
description: Tridel produces high-accuracy navigational charts compliant with international hydrographic standards (IHO). Our charting services support safe navigation for commercial shipping, recreational boating, and offshore operations.

name: UXO Survey
description: Tridel provides specialized survey services for the detection and mapping of Unexploded Ordnance (UXO). Using advanced magnetometry and acoustic imaging, we ensure safe clearance for offshore and coastal developments.

name: Vibro Coring
description: Our Vibro Coring services utilize high-frequency vibration techniques to collect undisturbed sediment samples from the seabed. This method is highly effective for sampling soft to stiff clays and sands, providing critical data for dredging, environmental studies, and pipeline route surveys.

name: Water Quality Monitoring
description: Tridel delivers comprehensive water quality monitoring solutions for marine, coastal, and inland waters. We deploy advanced sensors for real-time analysis of physical, chemical, and biological parameters.
